_comment: FROZEN at gate B0 (build-doc §8.4, §15). 32 colours, weighted k-means over the approved trial set. Ids c00-c31 are positional and stable; the freeze was a VALUE SWAP, not a schema change. Regenerate/verify with `npx tsx tools/palette/fit.mjs` (deterministic, k-means++ seeded at 42). Method and per-image error live in _method / _validation below and in assets/approved-trials/_palette-freeze/_fit-report.json.

_method.algorithm: weighted k-means, k=32, k-means++ init seeded at 42 via core/rng.ts (no Math.random, G11)
_method.weightingRationale: Each source image contributes equal total weight (1/N) regardless of pixel count, because the town map holds ~353k distinct colours against ~49-60k for the sprites (B-D5) and naive pixel-pooling lets it buy the palette and starve the sprite classes of hue.
_method.backgroundExcluded: The plain white backdrop (§9.2 prompt skeleton) is flood-filled from the border and excluded from the cluster input, along with a 2px dilation that drops the anti-aliased rim. It is not a content colour and a slot spent on it is stolen from the artwork.
_method.quantizerMetric: Scoring assigns each source colour the way tools/postprocess/steps.ts::quantize does — nearest palette entry by squared euclidean distance in sRGB — so the reported error is the error the pipeline will actually produce, not the error of an idealised quantizer.
_method.selectionRule: Six candidates (2 fit spaces x 3 weightings). Rule stated before the numbers were seen: minimise the MAXIMUM per-image mean ΔE2000 — "serves every asset class" is a claim about the worst class, not the mean. Ties within 0.05 break on the overall mean. OVERRIDDEN: the rule selected srgb/pooled; srgb/equal was frozen instead. Reason: The rule's instrument (per-image MEAN dE) cannot see a 1.29%-of-pixels feature. tools/palette/validate.mjs measures the L6 identity bands directly, and the rule's winner srgb/pooled degrades them badly: the player's star badge scores mean dE 8.33 with its core yellow #f5d300 mapping to ORANGE #eb991c at dE 19.9; skin 7.39; dark outline 6.31. srgb/equal scores star badge 2.93 (single swatch #f9db10, a true yellow), skin 4.02, outline 3.78, leather 3.02 - better on 4 of the 5 player identity bands, and only 0.36 worse on shirt green (2.49 vs 2.13, both invisible). Cost elsewhere is 0.12 on the worst-image mean (map 4.64 vs 4.52) and one fewer light neutral, which shifts the trainer's pale apron warm (worst-significant colour #e2e2e3 at dE 10.9). Gate B0 is about the CHARACTER surviving quantization, so the band measurement decides.
excluded: assets/approved-trials/player-style-reference.png (style reference carrying an L6-forbidden cape; not an approved asset)

source: k-means over the 5 approved trials (player, fox, croc, trainer, map), sRGB / equal weighting, seed 42 — gate B0
